prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one finished Jack of Spades playing-card artwork for Chinese-themed Design 2, a companion to the provided approved King. Input image is the authoritative STYLE AND LAYOUT REFERENCE, not the new character.
Match the reference's full 5:7 portrait card, ivory paper margin, fine gold outlines, narrow black outer lotus-vine band, scalloped ivory and pale-gold central reserve, dense black floral fields filled with teal foliage, red-and-ivory lotus flowers, small cream flowers and red berries. Preserve figure scale: relatively small head with room for abundant ornament, broad sleeves reaching both inner sides. Match crisp sumptuous painted print illustration, delicate gold embroidery, restrained natural face modeling, diagonal waist join with turquoise central jewel.
Replace the King with a handsome young adult Chinese male court attendant about 25, slender and dignified. Ming-inspired round-collared deep Prussian-blue silk robe, madder red inner collar edged ivory, broad sleeves, teal/madder/gold lotus and cloud embroidery, jade-plaque belt. Decorative floral chest panel, no imperial dragon roundel. Black gauze wushamao-inspired official cap with modest short flat side wings; no crown, no tall upright emperor wings, no feather, no beard. Small neat moustache.
ESSENTIAL SPADE JACK IDENTITY: upper face in strict profile toward the VIEWER'S LEFT, nose projecting LEFT, exactly ONE visible eye. Hold an upright infantry pike on the VIEWER'S RIGHT: slender dark wooden shaft, a small steel leaf-shaped spearhead and compact gold socket; spearhead entirely inside the inner frame, not a broad sword blade. Free hand rests at chest. Bottom figure must be a 180-degree rotated counterpart: bottom nose projects to the page RIGHT and bottom pike on page LEFT. Balanced double-ended card with matching features in both orientations.
Indices: large black serif 'J' above a solid black spade in upper-left ivory cartouche; identical cartouche rotated 180 degrees in lower-right. No K, no other lettering, no watermark. Preserve reference framing and ornamental density, all figure and weapon parts contained inside. Output a single full card only, straight-on, no mockup, 1060 x 1484 pixels or same exact 5:7 ratio.
